name: Karnataka Raitha Siri Scheme
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka
short_description: Incentive of Rs. 10,000 per hectare directly credited to farmers cultivating minor millets (Siri Dhanya) in Karnataka.
detailed_description: Raitha Siri promotes millet farming by offering financial assistance of Rs. 10,000 per hectare (up to a maximum of 2 hectares) to farmers cultivating designated minor millets like Foxtail, Kodo, Little, Barnyard, and Proso millets in Karnataka.
description_kannada: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿರಿಧಾನ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಬೆಳೆಯುವ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ಹೆಕ್ಟೇರ್‌ಗೆ ರೂ. 10,000 ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹಧನ ನೀಡುವ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಯೋಜನೆ.

rules.name: Resident of Karnataka
rules.source_citation: Karnataka Agriculture Dept Order on Siri Dhanya Incentive
rules.clarification_question_en: Are you a farmer cultivating land in Karnataka?

benefits_summary: Financial grant of Rs. 10,000 per hectare up to a ceiling of 2 hectares (max Rs. 20,000).
required_documents: Farmer Registration and Unified Beneficiary Information System (FRUITS) ID
application_process: Enroll with FRUITS portal (fruits.karnataka.gov.in) through the local Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK).
Declare millet crop sowing in the crop survey mobile app.
Upon inspection by the Agriculture officer, incentive is transferred via DBT.
source_title: Department of Agriculture, Govt of Karnataka
source_excerpt: To encourage the cultivation of minor millets, the State Government provides Rs. 10,000 per hectare direct incentive to registered farmers.
